owner_approval_gate.description: Any change to protected paths requires explicit owner decision before merge.

decision_options.label: Deny
decision_options.effect: Block the change. Close or reject the PR. Log decision.

decision_options.label: Allow once
decision_options.effect: Permit this PR only. Does not grant standing permission.

decision_options.label: Always allow
decision_options.effect: Add path or agent to standing allow-list. Still logged. Owner may revoke.

surface: PR description must list every protected path changed
Owner must comment or use review with one of: DENY / ALLOW ONCE / ALWAYS ALLOW
No agent may merge protected-path changes without recorded owner decision

triage.on_failure: Keep run visible. Create or update triage item. Notify owner. Do not hide or cancel.
triage.owner_action: Approve or deny the repair before any further merge.

required_loop: understand existing design and owner request
if protected path changed: present Deny / Allow once / Always allow and wait
rule: Local first. Never use cloud first. Never run hosted dependency checks for pull requests. Owner decision required for workflow and policy files.
